items:
A work permit must be issued, 
 the maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding work area is required.
Wear the safety and healthy equipment.

Isolate the circuit 
 breaker of the pump motor.

Disconnect electric 
 terminals of the pump motor.

The pump must be isolated mechanically by closing delivery and suction 
 valves.

Be sure pump must be 
 completely drained.
Complete maintenance tool set.
Safety helmets, shoes, earplug and gloves pairs etc.

Cleaning fluid, manual puller,
 Rags
Feeler gauge, dial indicator.
Vibrometer, straight edge.
Check discharge quantity and pressure and record them.

Check the vibration level of the pump set complete with the 
 motor then, record them.

Check radial and 
 axial clearances of the pump impeller.
Check alignment between pump shaft and motor shaft.
Unscrew the bolts of the motor base plate and take it out.

Dismantle the pump half coupling complete with the control 
 shaft gear box after releasing the drive nut.

Dismantle the electric connection bushing of the control 
 shaft gearbox drive.

Dismantle the discharge elbow from the base plate fixation 
 and the discharge flange

Lift the pump complete and place it on its erection pads in 
 the workshop.

Dismantle the cover of the bearings and discharge oil from 
 the oil tank.
Dismantle the cooling coil from its attached pipes.

Dismount the tapered roller bearing and the angular contact 
 ball bearing
Dismantle the oil tank compete with the oil deflector.
Dismantle the gland and remove the old packing cords.

Dismantle the bolts of the bell mouth flange from the 
 discharge elbow flange and lift the elbow up carefully avoiding damaging the 
 shaft.

Dismantle the impeller from the main shaft flangeand lift it 
 up avoid to damage the impeller blades control shaft.

Dismantle the cover of the impeller hub and unscrew the 
 retaining nut of the of the control shaft with the swiveling disc of the 
 impeller blades hinges.

Check run-out of the main shaft and the control shaft, then 
 repair if possible otherwise replace by new one.

Check all parts from any worn-out and repair if possible 
 otherwise replace by new one.

The validity of 
 the anti-friction ball bearings.

Check all parts 
 for any worn-out and replace them by new ones.

Inspect the 
 run-out of shafts (allowance 0.03 mm).

Clean the casing of the pump from the mud and use steel 
 brush to remove any rust and repaint.
Clean all contact surfaces after removing the old gaskets.

Insert the control shaft in the impeller and tight it with 
 the retaining nut, then raise it up and down to ensure that the blades hinges 
 working properly.

Cover the impeller hub (ensure that the control shaft is 
 centered in the journal bearing in the impeller cover).

Lift the main shaft of the pump up and tight it with the 
 impeller avoid to damage the control shaft.

Lift all assembled parts complete (impeller-main 
 shaft-control shaft) and insert them in the bell mouth.
Install the discharge elbow to the bell mouth flange.
Mount the oil tank in its stand at the elbow.
Mount the oil deflector in the oil tank.

Install the cooling coil in the oil tank and attach it to 
 the water inlet and outlet pipes after cleaning all pipes by air blast, then 
 re-fill the oil tank with clean oil.
Cover the oil tank.

Lift the pump and put it in its bedplate and tight it to the 
 foundation and the discharge flange.

Rotate the pump by hand and ensure that it rotates easily, 
 otherwise interfere to check the reasons.

Mount the gearbox drive after checking gears teeth and the 
 roller bearings of its shafts and fill it with clean oil.
Install the electric bushing connection.

Put the motor on its bedplate and adjust the alignment, then 
 tight its bolts.
Tight the bolts of the coupling and corer them with guard.
Repack the stuffing box and tight the gland bolts by hand.

Check the direction of 
 rotation of pump before starting the pump for the first time.

Check the quantity of 
 oil in the thrust-bearing sump.

Open the inlet for 
 cooling the oil bath of the thrust bearing.

Check whether the 
 inlet for flooding the stuffing box is open.

Check whether the 
 inlet for hydraulic sealing of the suspension is open.

Check whether the 
 delivery sluice valve is closed.

Open the delivery 
 valve gradually after the set has been started to operate at its full speed.

The temperature of the 
 anti-friction bearing in the bearing top which should not exceed 75C.

The oil level in 
 bearing top according to the mark on the oil gauge.

The temperature of 
 cooling water at discharge.

Introduction
This document outlines the equipment inspection list I1, 
 to be carried out every five years 
 as indicated by Y5 in the above title block.
This pump is a vertical diagonal pump with 
 swiveling of the impeller blade, its function to condensate the steam 
 of turbine in condenser.
Technical 
 specification
Type of 
 pump | Sigma 1000 
 BQDV 1290 36 LU 00
Design | Vertical mixed flow 
 regulating pump in wet sump
Liquid 
 temperature max | 30 C
Pump 
 capacity | 12844.8 m3/h ( 3568 l/s )
Specific 
 energy | 19 m w.c. ( 186 j/kg )
Speed of 
 pump | 496 rpm.
Efficiency | 80%
Weight of 
 pump | 9800 
 kg/pc
Torque 
 moment | 17360 Nm
Bearing Type | 29456 
 6056MB
The first draft initiated & tested by eng. Medhat

This document accepted by eng. Samir Abd El 
 Gilil: EDEPC inspection & quality control general director, MPIS coordinator, 
 and certified by accountant Mahmoud Soliman EDEPC admin & financial inspection 
 & quality control's general director and supervisor of inspection & quality 
 control head sector.
Safety 
Precautions
A work permit must be issued, 
 the maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding work area is required.
Wear the safety and healthy equipment.
Isolate the circuit 
 breaker of the pump motor.
Disconnect electric 
 terminals of the pump motor.
The pump must be isolated mechanically by closing delivery and suction 
 valves.
Be sure pump must be 
 completely drained.
Tools 
and Equipment
Complete maintenance tool set.
Safety helmets, shoes, earplug and gloves pairs etc.
Cleaning fluid, manual puller,
 Rags
Feeler gauge, dial indicator.
Vibrometer, straight edge.
Work to be carried out
Disassembly
Pump In Operation
Check discharge quantity and pressure and record them.
Check the vibration level of the pump set complete with the 
 motor then, record them.
Pump 
out of Operation
Check radial and 
 axial clearances of the pump impeller.
Check alignment between pump shaft and motor shaft.
Unscrew the bolts of the motor base plate and take it out.
Dismantle the pump half coupling complete with the control 
 shaft gear box after releasing the drive nut.
Dismantle the electric connection bushing of the control 
 shaft gearbox drive.
Dismantle the discharge elbow from the base plate fixation 
 and the discharge flange
Lift the pump complete and place it on its erection pads in 
 the workshop.
Dismantle the cover of the bearings and discharge oil from 
 the oil tank.
Dismantle the cooling coil from its attached pipes.
Dismount the tapered roller bearing and the angular contact 
 ball bearing
Dismantle the oil tank compete with the oil deflector.
Dismantle the gland and remove the old packing cords.
Dismantle the bolts of the bell mouth flange from the 
 discharge elbow flange and lift the elbow up carefully avoiding damaging the 
 shaft.
Dismantle the impeller from the main shaft flangeand lift it 
 up avoid to damage the impeller blades control shaft.
Dismantle the cover of the impeller hub and unscrew the 
 retaining nut of the of the control shaft with the swiveling disc of the 
 impeller blades hinges.
Check run-out of the main shaft and the control shaft, then 
 repair if possible otherwise replace by new one.
Check all parts from any worn-out and repair if possible 
 otherwise replace by new one.
Inspection
The validity of 
 the anti-friction ball bearings.
Check all parts 
 for any worn-out and replace them by new ones.
Inspect the 
 run-out of shafts (allowance 0.03 mm).
Assembly
Clean the casing of the pump from the mud and use steel 
 brush to remove any rust and repaint.
Clean all contact surfaces after removing the old gaskets.
Insert the control shaft in the impeller and tight it with 
 the retaining nut, then raise it up and down to ensure that the blades hinges 
 working properly.
Cover the impeller hub (ensure that the control shaft is 
 centered in the journal bearing in the impeller cover).
Lift the main shaft of the pump up and tight it with the 
 impeller avoid to damage the control shaft.
Lift all assembled parts complete (impeller-main 
 shaft-control shaft) and insert them in the bell mouth.
Install the discharge elbow to the bell mouth flange.
Mount the oil tank in its stand at the elbow.
Mount the oil deflector in the oil tank.
Mount the angular contact bearing and the taper roller 
 bearing , in the same moment adjust the clearance of the pump impeller ( 6 mm 
 ).
Install the cooling coil in the oil tank and attach it to 
 the water inlet and outlet pipes after cleaning all pipes by air blast, then 
 re-fill the oil tank with clean oil.
Cover the oil tank.
Lift the pump and put it in its bedplate and tight it to the 
 foundation and the discharge flange.
Rotate the pump by hand and ensure that it rotates easily, 
 otherwise interfere to check the reasons.
Mount the gearbox drive after checking gears teeth and the 
 roller bearings of its shafts and fill it with clean oil.
Install the electric bushing connection.
Put the motor on its bedplate and adjust the alignment, then 
 tight its bolts.
Tight the bolts of the coupling and corer them with guard.
Repack the stuffing box and tight the gland bolts by hand.
Starting of Pump
Check the direction of 
 rotation of pump before starting the pump for the first time.
Check the quantity of 
 oil in the thrust-bearing sump.
Open the inlet for 
 cooling the oil bath of the thrust bearing.
Check whether the 
 inlet for flooding the stuffing box is open.
Check whether the 
 inlet for hydraulic sealing of the suspension is open.
Check whether the 
 delivery sluice valve is closed.
Open the delivery 
 valve gradually after the set has been started to operate at its full speed.
Attendance and checking 
During Operation
The temperature of the 
 anti-friction bearing in the bearing top which should not exceed 75C.
The oil level in 
 bearing top according to the mark on the oil gauge.
The temperature of 
 cooling water at discharge.
